Get Organization Variables only reads gen_etlvariable (gen_key/gen_value by package scope) and sets User::OrganizationName/ServerName (connection parameters); no CRM write, no business filter.

WHERE is 'gen_joiningstatus in(7,8) and (A) or (B)'; SQL AND binds tighter than OR, so it is (status in (7,8) AND A) OR B; B rows are selected regardless of gen_joiningstatus and flow to Update Contact.

UpdateEmailAgreement/UpdateMarketingAgreement are computed in SQL and are inputs of Update Contact but never referenced in main.cs; the script tests only gennewcompanyemailagreement==1 / gennewmarketinginquiriesagreement==1, so a row selected through B with gen_newcompanyemailagreement=1 also gets donotsendmm=false without A's date/donotsendmm conditions.

main.cs:130-137 always sets contact["gen_notauthorizeforuse"] (OptionSetValue or null) for every row with ContactId; the derived value is the joining's gen_notauthorizetousedatasource (or NULL in the special case), so a NULL value clears the contact field.
